title: 사법정책자문위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00016:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 12 (Duties)
(1) Expert members shall perform the following duties:
1. Collection of materials, investigation, research, and review concerning matters to be deliberated on by the Committee or its subcommittees, and reporting of the results;
2. Other matters requested by the Committee or its subcommittees.
(2) Where necessary, the chairperson of the Committee may establish an expert-member research group according to matters under deliberation by the Committee or its subcommittees and have the group conduct research and reviews.
(3) The Committee or a subcommittee may have expert members attend meetings to state opinions and provide explanations.
